notes.title: One layout on every page
notes.body: The sidebar sits on the left, the page title at the top, and details open beside the list instead of over it.

notes.title: Narrow screens and zoom
notes.body: On a narrow window, or at 200% zoom, the sidebar folds into an Open navigation menu and nothing needs sideways scrolling.

notes.title: What's new
notes.body: Open What's new in the sidebar to read these notes again. A New label shows beside it until you have opened them.
